label: Leave Request — English
text: Sir, I need leave tomorrow because of a family emergency. My grandfather is in hospital and I have to go home urgently. Please approve my leave for 21st August 2026.

expected_payload.subject: Leave Request Approved — Priya Mehta
expected_payload.body:
Dear Teacher,

This is to inform you that the leave request from Priya Mehta (student) for 21st August 2026 has been reviewed and approved.

Reason: Family emergency — grandfather hospitalized.

Regards,
AI College Request System

demo_notes: Lead demo scenario. Shows the core happy path: webhook → AI → Notion → approval → email. Narrate each step.

label: Event Booking
text: Ma'am, our CS department wants to book the main auditorium on 15th September 2026 for the Annual Tech Fest. We need it from 9 AM to 6 PM. Around 300 students will attend.

expected_payload.title: Annual Tech Fest — CS Department
expected_payload.description: Main auditorium booking for Annual Tech Fest. 9 AM–6 PM. ~300 attendees. Requested by Arjun Nair.

label: Maintenance Request
text: The AC in Room 204 has been broken for 3 days. It's very hot and students can't focus. Please send someone to fix it as soon as possible.

expected_payload.subject: Maintenance Request — Room 204 AC
expected_payload.body:
Dear Facilities Team,

A maintenance request has been filed for Room 204. The AC unit has been non-functional for 3 days.

Priority: High — affecting student concentration.

Please schedule repair at earliest.

Regards,
AI College Request System

demo_notes: Shows a non-leave category. Good for showing breadth of what the system handles.

label: Ambiguous / Invalid Request (graceful escalation)
text: hello sir please do the needful and help me with my thing thanks

expected_outcome.notes: Should NOT auto-complete. Must route to human review. This proves the system is safe.

demo_notes: ★ RELIABILITY MOMENT ★ Submit this and narrate: 'Even when someone sends vague garbage, our system doesn't crash or guess — it flags it for human review. Safety > speed.' This is what separates us from a toy prototype.
